title: CRLR/495/2022 of BHUWAN CHANDRA JOSHI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Criminal Revision No. 495 of 2022
Bhuwan Chandra Joshi ..........Revisionist
Vs.
State of Uttarakhand and another ........ Respondents

Present : Mr. Shobhit Joshi and Mr. Tarun Joshi, Advocates for the
revisionist.
 Mr. Lalit Miglani, A.G.A. with Ms. Sonika Khulbe, Brief Holder for the
State.

JUDGMENT
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
 The challenge in this revision is made to the
order dated 30.05.2022, passed in Criminal Case No.77 of
2021, Smt. Meenakshi Joshi vs. Bhuwan Chandra Joshi,
passed by the court of Judge, Family Court Haldwani,
District Nainital (for short, "the case").
2. By the impugned order, the revisionist has
been directed to pay `9,000/- as an interim maintenance
to his wife. The case is based on an application filed by
the respondent no.2, the wife against the revisionist
seeking maintenance.

2
3. In the instant case, an application for interim
maintenance has been filed. According to it, after marriage
on 21.11.2013, the wife was taunted for demand of
additional dowry. When the wife give birth to a baby girl,
she was further tortured, harassed and in the year 2018,
she was made to abort a foetus. Finally, on 05.11.20149,
she was dropped by the revisionist at Haldwani bus station.
Since then, the wife is staying with her parents. There is no
means to maintain herself whereas, the revisionist is a
Forest Guard. In the case, an application for interim
maintenance has been filed, which was objected to by the
revisionist, but by the impugned order, it has been allowed
and the revisionist has been directed to pay the
maintenance, as stated hereinbefore.
4. Learned counsel for the revisionist would
submit that the wife had deserted the revisionist without
any cause; the revisionist has ever been ready and willing to
keep his wife with him; the revisionist has also filed a
petition under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
seeking institution of the conjugal rights. In addition to it,
learned counsel would also submit that the amount of
interim maintenance is in excess because the revisionist
has the liability to maintain his mother and his daughter.

3
5. The issues raised in this revision had already
been raised in the court below and has been discussed in
the impugned order. This is a revision, the scope is quite
limited to the extent of examining, legality, propriety and
correctness of the impugned judgment.
6. At this stage, when these lines were dictated,
learned counsel for the revisionist would further submit
that since, the wife is staying away from the revisionist
without any sufficient cause, she is not entitled to
maintenance. He would also submit that at least the notice
be issued to the wife, so that the matter may be settled.
7. The intention of amicable settling the family
discord is really a very welcome gesture, but then, the case
is still pending in the court below. The parties may sit
together and even the matter may be referred to mediation,
so that the parties may arrive at a settlement. Needless to
say, in a situation of amicable settlement, it is WIN-WIN
situation for both the parties. But, merely because of the
chances of amicable settlement, the revision cannot be
admitted unless there is something which may requires the
Court to make an intervention.
8. The relationship of husband and wife is
admitted. According to the revisionist, wife is educated. But

4
does she earn? There is no record to it. It is admitted that
the revisionist is a Government employee. The impugned
order records that in the month of February, 2022, he
received 34,680/-. There are versions, as to why the wife is
staying away. According to the wife, she was tortured and
dropped by the revisionist at Haldwani bus stand and
according to the revisionist, she is staying without any
sufficient cause. These are the triable issues, which can
finally be determined in the case.
9. The court below after considering of all the
aspects of the matter fixed the amount of interim
maintenance as `9,000/-. In every case of this nature there
is always an element of estimation, while fixing the amount
of maintenance. In the instant case, this Court is of the view
that whatever amount has been fixed, it cannot be said to
be excessive. The impugned order is in accordance with law.
It does not warrant any interference. Accordingly, the
revision deserves to be dismissed at the stage of admission
itself.
10. The revision is dismissed in limine.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 31.08.2022
Sanjay
